post_call_extraction_draft_v16.name: booking_succeeded
post_call_extraction_draft_v16.rule: True only after book_appointment_cal returns success and Isabella confirms the booking; false for a failed or incomplete booking; empty when no booking was attempted.

post_call_extraction_draft_v16.name: sms_consent_granted
post_call_extraction_draft_v16.rule: True only after the post-booking consent question receives a clear affirmative answer; false only for a clear decline; otherwise empty.

post_call_extraction_draft_v16.name: sms_consent_evidence
post_call_extraction_draft_v16.rule: Quote or closely transcribe the SMS consent question and caller response; otherwise empty.
